title: Wings live: Hammersmith Odeon, London | 1979
content:
Wings performed at London’s Hammersmith Odeon on 14 September 1979.

The show was for Buddy Holly Week, which was organised by Paul McCartney and MPL.

McCartney performed with Wings and Holly’s backing group The Crickets during the show. Other performers included Albert Lee, Bob Montgomery, and Don Everly.

Denny Laine performed ‘Raining In My Heart’ with Everly, and all of Wings performed ‘It’s So Easy!’. The grand finale was a version of ‘Bo Diddley’, followed by an encore of The Crickets performing ‘Rave On’.

Wings had previously performed at the Hammersmith Odeon on 25, 26, and 27 May 1973, and 17 and 18 September 1975. They returned there for their final live show on 29 December 1979.
